description: Mapa de calles de Port de la Selva is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by elportdelaselva.cat. The Street Map of Port de la Selva is a set of mapping data that, using an interactive map viewer, shows the names of the streets in Port de la Selva and their location. In addition, more accurate PDF maps can also be accessed. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Port de la Selva street map" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Callejero, Municipality, Port de la Selva, Carrerer, Street map, Municipo. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
